Title: New Machine Learning capabilities on the Azure Marketplace

Body.Content:
We have added to the Azure Marketplace examples of APIs that were built with Azure Machine Learning. These APIs are free to use, and illustrate how the reach and power of the cloud allow advanced analytics to be consumed in more ways. Examples of new Machine Learning capabilities on the Azure Marketplace:
  • 15 R packages: check out the Sentiment Analysis API or Forecasting API.
  • Three high-value, finished SaaS offerings: see Anomaly Detection, Recommendations, and Frequently Bought Together.
  • Three Machine Learning services from our partner Versium Analytics: Giving Score, Green Score, and Wealth Score.
Visit the Azure Marketplace, or learn more on the Azure Machine Learning page.
